text.en: 1. This Code is the Highway (Revision) Code 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.
2. In the Highway Code (R 11), in Part III, in the Part heading, after “PEDAL CYCLISTS”, insert “, RECUMBENT DEVICE RIDERS”.
3. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 36, after “bicycle” wherever it appears, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”.

4. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 38 —
(a)after “bicycle’s” wherever it appears, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle’s or recumbent device’s”;
(b)after “either side of the bicycle”, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”; and
(c)after “full control of the bicycle”, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”.

5. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 39 —
(a)after “bicycle” wherever it appears, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”; and
(b)after “bicycle’s”, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle’s or recumbent device’s”.
6. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 40, after “bicycle”, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”.
7. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 41, after “bicycle”, insert “, three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device”.
8. In the Highway Code, in paragraph 44C, after “personal mobility device”, insert “(other than a three‑wheeled pedal cycle or recumbent device)”.
